summary: Estimate logical/final non-deduplicating scalar aggregates as exactly one row, retaining input cost and a finite output-width estimate.
review: Independent patch generated directly from pinned base; production worktrees unchanged.
Second pass checked the pinned-base ordered-IU API; keys use Items().empty().
validation_plan: Assert exact ERows=1 on empty/nonempty scalar aggregates in Undefined and Final phases.
Verify Intermediate aggregates and grouping-only/dedup operators do not acquire global-one cardinality.
Check finite EBytes for zero input rows/columns and zero/invalid width estimates.
Check downstream selectivity and join costing while preserving aggregate input processing cost.
limits: Output width remains a heuristic: scaled input average width, or eight bytes per output column when unavailable.
Grouped aggregate cardinality/cost modeling is not changed.
The guard on grouped width division only avoids division by zero; it does not add a grouped cardinality estimator.
